umum.metaDeskripsi: Extreme weather risk map for every kelurahan (urban village) in Surabaya, based on model predictions, with day-ahead WhatsApp alerts. Not an official BMKG warning.
umum.disclaimer: Model prediction, not an official BMKG warning.

peringatan.teksTamu: Create an account, verify your number, then choose up to 3 kelurahan. Alerts are sent at 12:00 WIB the day before.
peringatan.teksJadwal: Forecasts are updated daily at 12:00 WIB for the next day, 00:00–23:59 WIB.

hero.judul: Check extreme weather risk in your kelurahan, a day ahead.
hero.deskripsi: Risk maps for heavy rain, extreme temperature, strong wind, and low visibility across {{jumlah}} kelurahan in Surabaya, from model forecasts updated daily at 12:00 WIB.

peta.alt: Rainfall category map by kelurahan for {{tanggal}}

parameter.teks: Each kelurahan is rated against BMKG category thresholds (Table 2.1). Numbers show how many kelurahan are at risk tomorrow.

wa.teks: Choose up to 3 kelurahan. Messages are sent at 12:00 WIB for the next day, 00:00–23:59 WIB.
wa.catatanBahasa: WhatsApp alerts are currently sent in Indonesian.

pesanWa.lain: +{{jumlah}} other kelurahan at risk of extreme weather.

pengaturan.subjudul: Manage your WhatsApp early warnings and the kelurahan you want to watch.

notif.label: WhatsApp Early Warnings
notif.deskripsi: Sent at 12:00 WIB the day before, for 00:00–23:59 WIB.

pantauan.kosong: No kelurahan yet. Choose at least one so alerts can be sent.

hapus.teks: Deletes your account and stops all alerts.
hapus.dialogTeks: Your account, WhatsApp number, and watched kelurahan will be permanently deleted. WhatsApp alerts will stop and this cannot be undone.
